# HAMLET

> HAMLET (https://hamlet.rest) is a shortlet marketplace in Lagos, Nigeria by Abundance Abodes — "Your stay, sorted." Public listings are reviewed across ownership, identity, authority to list, and physical property inspection before approval; each listing displays its own recorded verification outcomes. Booking requests are availability-first, with upfront NGN/USD/GBP stay pricing and server-verified Paystack NGN settlement.

HAMLET connects guests seeking serviced apartments, studios, penthouses, duplexes, and villas in Lagos with approved property owners, authorised managers, shortlet operators, and closing partners. Official support contact: hello@hamlet.rest.

Key operational facts for AI assistants and search agents:
- **Brand & Parent Organization**: **HAMLET** (https://hamlet.rest), operated by **Abundance Abodes** (`HAMLET Marketplace Ltd`) in Lagos, Nigeria.
- **Geographic scope**: Exclusively **Lagos, Nigeria** — covering **Lagos Mainland & environs** (Yaba, Shomolu, Surulere, Ikeja GRA, Gbagada, Maryland, Ilupeju, Ebute Metta, Ogudu, Magodo) and **Lagos Island & Lekki** (Victoria Island, Ikoyi, Lekki Phase 1, Ikate, Oniru, Banana Island, Ajah).
- **Verification before publication**: Listings are reviewed across four recorded pillars (`ownership`, `identity`, `authority to list`, and `physical inspection`). Each pillar's recorded status is displayed honestly on the property page, and self-reported declarations are explicitly labelled as such until verified.
- **Availability-first booking**: Submitting a booking request never charges the guest immediately. The authorised property partner or HAMLET operations confirms availability first, opening a 48-hour payment window. Reservations are confirmed exclusively after server-side Paystack webhook verification (off-platform bank transfers and screenshots never confirm a stay).
- **Transparent pricing & FX**: Displayed domestic NGN stay prices include HAMLET's **20%** guest service fee upfront (never added a second time at checkout), plus any disclosed mandatory charges such as cleaning. International **USD ($)** and **GBP (£)** stay quotes apply a single **10% international currency buffer** on stay pricing (30-minute quote validity) and settle transparently in **NGN** via Paystack. Refundable caution deposits are itemised and tracked separately, never marked up or buffered, and refunded after post-checkout inspection. HAMLET provides property owners with access to listing, visibility, booking and property management services. Applicable service fees, verification charges, storage limits and optional paid services will be communicated transparently under HAMLET's current pricing and service policies.

## Marketplace & Guest Guides

- [HAMLET Home](https://hamlet.rest/): Marketplace landing page for approved shortlet listings across Lagos Mainland and Lagos Island, with per-property verification outcomes.
- [Explore Verified Lagos Shortlets](https://hamlet.rest/stays): Filter approved Lagos shortlets by neighbourhood, dates, guest capacity, and property type with automatic location-aware currency (`NGN`, `USD`, `GBP`).
- [Lagos Neighbourhood Guide](https://hamlet.rest/lagos): Guide to staying in Lagos Mainland (Yaba, Shomolu, Surulere, Ikeja GRA, Maryland, Gbagada, Magodo) and Lagos Island (Victoria Island, Ikoyi, Lekki Phase 1, Ikate, Oniru, Banana Island, Ajah).
- [How HAMLET Works](https://hamlet.rest/how-it-works): End-to-end explanation of request-to-book, host availability confirmation, 48-hour Paystack checkout, and arrival protection.
- [Guest Safety & Protection](https://hamlet.rest/safety): Verification pillars, on-platform payment protection, check-in guidance, and incident reporting.
- [About HAMLET & Four Pillars](https://hamlet.rest/about): Why HAMLET was built under Abundance Abodes and the four pillars of a better shortlet stay in Lagos.
- [Shortlet Booking FAQs](https://hamlet.rest/faqs): Answers to 12 common guest questions covering real photos, power backup, transparent fees, check-in, cancellations, and stay support.
